ActionPlan.description:
The plan of section 9.6. The plan hash (A.4) is taken over `model_dump(mode="json")`, so
equal plans hold every list in one stable order.
ActionPlan.title: ActionPlan

artifact_hash.description: The payload hash shown with the draft. Required when the item is a draft or a review that holds a draft, and omitted otherwise. Which item it is, is known to the handler, so the schema leaves the field optional.
artifact_hash.title: Artifact Hash

Assumption.description: One unknown input and the case taken for it, in A.6's condition form.
Assumption.title: Assumption

AutonomySetting.description: The `autonomy.<command_class>` setting of a class autonomy applies to (7.4).
AutonomySetting.title: AutonomySetting

BlockerDetail.description: What a blocker carries beyond its kind and owner; also the shape of `blockers.detail_json`.
BlockerDetail.title: BlockerDetail

BlockerView.description:
An open blocker. `item_id` is `blockers.id`, the id an `approve` or `reject` names.

The detail pane offers the actions for every open item (section 11), so the blocker carries
what its action needs: a pending observation's value (`observation`, required exactly for the
item kind `observation`), a review's cause as a registered name (`review_cause`, required
exactly for the item kind `review`, equal to `detail.cause`) and, for a held draft, the payload
hash an `approve` carries (`held_draft_payload_hash`, 7.4).
BlockerView.title: BlockerView

ChatRequest.description: One chat turn; the server holds the conversation.
ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest

ChatResponse.description:
One answer. Asked to approve or reject, the assistant creates no card and points the
underwriter to the item instead (7.4, A.11): `item_ids` are the items the answer points to.
ChatResponse.title: ChatResponse

CoverageAdjustmentEffect.description: A proposed value for a coverage field; the submitted value stays with the facts.
CoverageAdjustmentEffect.title: CoverageAdjustmentEffect

DraftView.description: One of the lead's intents (A.1). A reply is accepted only for one in state `sent`.
DraftView.title: DraftView

EventRow.description:
An `events` row. `payload` is an object that follows `PAYLOAD_MODELS[type]`; the row checks
it, so the schema stays one object type rather than 28 row variants.
EventRow.title: EventRow

ExternalLink.description: A search or map link where the board calls for a human look (section 11).
ExternalLink.title: ExternalLink

FactView.description: An effective fact with its source tag. `p_f` is a fact like any other.
FactView.title: FactView

LeadDetail.description:
`GET /api/leads/{id}`. The rule traces are the plan's (`effects[].trace`,
`declines_on_every_branch`) and the playbook pages'.
LeadDetail.title: LeadDetail

LeadNote.description:
A non-blocking note (section 11): a page or row not evaluated (4.1), or a skill that is
unevaluated or on its fallback (section 8). `ref` is a row, page or skill id.
LeadNote.title: LeadNote

ObligationEffect.description: A post-bind obligation; recorded and never executed.
ObligationEffect.title: ObligationEffect

OpenChoiceView.description: An open underwriter choice with the values of the fields it shows (section 11).
OpenChoiceView.title: OpenChoiceView

PlaybookPage.description:
One line of the playbook path checklist (section 11). `applies` is `unknown` when the
page's `applies_when` rests on an unknown fact: the graph is undecided and contributes
nothing (9.6). A page that does not apply has no result and no effects. `exception` marks
what the exceptions-only toggle shows: an undecided page, a decline, a page that applies and
was not evaluated, or any effect other than `no_action`.
PlaybookPage.title: PlaybookPage

ProposalView.description: A `proposals` row (A.1). A command proposal's payload is `{type, payload, rationale}`.
ProposalView.title: ProposalView

ProposeCommandPayload.description:
`{type, payload, rationale}` (A.11): `type` and `payload` together are one of the ten
proposable HTTP commands, never `approve`, `reject` or `propose_command`. The payload is read as
the model of `type` before the union field sees it.
ProposeCommandPayload.title: ProposeCommandPayload

QuestionItem.description: The lead's open choices as one card (section 11). `item_id` is the question blocker's id.
QuestionItem.title: QuestionItem

QueueRow.description:
One row per lead, in the order the response lists them. The one-sentence summary is
`GET /api/run`'s `summary`, not part of this response.
QueueRow.title: QueueRow

ReplyRequest.description: `POST /api/replies` and the `deliver_reply` payload; the body is capped at 8,000 characters (A.9).
ReplyRequest.title: ReplyRequest

ReplyResponse.description: Returned after the reply has been read and the lead re-evaluated, or refused.
ReplyResponse.title: ReplyResponse

ReviewItem.description:
An open review: `item` says which A.11 row it is, so the client knows what `approve` and
`reject` do. A draft row carries the draft whose `payload_hash` an `approve` echoes.
ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem

RuleTrace.description: Either one path or a set of alternatives, never both.
RuleTrace.title: RuleTrace

RunSummary.description:
The one-sentence summary's seven counts (section 11).

`follow_ups_sent` counts every request sent to a producer, in any round. The four waiting
counts count each lead once, by its primary next action: an underwriter review or question, a
producer reply, a data blocker, or an unknown delivery.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunView.description:
`GET /api/run`; also the reply of `POST /api/run/start`. Before a run starts `run_id` and
`sim_now` are null and the counts are zero.
RunView.title: RunView

SkillResult.description: `skill_results.<name>` of the latest scored run row that matches the skill's digest (section 8).
SkillResult.title: SkillResult

TraceBranch.description: One alternative of a decline on every branch: the cases taken for the unknown inputs and the path that follows.
TraceBranch.title: TraceBranch

200.description: Server-sent events; each carries an event id.

Response List Leads Api Leads Get
